sourceBasis: human real-device rejection of C-04 v5 on 2026-09-12
initial concept diagrams: user creates Boxes and places work/tests inside them
Core vNext v2.3 typed entities and dependency/impact principles
principles: Box is a generic user-created container; developers do not assign business/domain purpose.
UI Box, Schema Box, Test Box and similar names are examples a user may create, never built-in Box types.
Dependency is the system structural relation. Any human-facing relation label/classification is user-defined free text, never a developer enum.
Reverse impact is derived from the single canonical dependency record.
Task and Test remain typed system entities because the user explicitly requested them as Box contents; a Box may contain multiple of each.
Legacy v5 boxType/kind values are read-only compatibility metadata; v6 new writes do not require or generate developer-defined enumerations.
On mobile, workspace content must dominate the first viewport; repository/project chrome and navigation must not consume half the screen.

acceptance.title: Generic Box registration
acceptance.criteria: A new Box requires only a user-chosen name. Optional classification/description are free text. No built-in ui/schema/test/custom type selector exists and no v6 Box write requires boxType.

acceptance.title: User-defined classification
acceptance.criteria: Users can enter arbitrary Box classification text (including blank). The value is displayed as metadata only and never changes behavior, validation, grouping rules, or available fields.

acceptance.title: Multiple Box members
acceptance.criteria: Each new Task/Test belongs to one registered Box and each Box may contain multiple Tasks and Tests. Box cards expose counts and member rows.

acceptance.title: Generic dependency
acceptance.criteria: A Dependency stores dependent -> prerequisite exactly once. Optional relationLabel/note are user-entered free text. No uses/schema/ui/test/data/sequence enum or default is generated by v6.

acceptance.title: Reverse impact
acceptance.criteria: Every dependency is traversable as depends-on and reverse-derived impacts without a duplicated reverse record, for Box/Task/Test endpoints.

acceptance.title: At-a-glance dependency flags
acceptance.criteria: Each Box card visibly shows Task count, Test count, dependency count, and impact count without opening details.

acceptance.title: Compact mobile chrome
acceptance.criteria: At 390x844, after a project is open the first workspace content begins no lower than 300 CSS px. Repository/project controls are collapsed into a compact disclosure and do not permanently occupy the upper half of the viewport.

acceptance.title: Compact navigation
acceptance.criteria: At 390x844, workspace tabs remain one horizontally scrollable row rather than wrapping into multiple rows; primary workspace content remains visible in the first viewport.

acceptance.title: Safety and compatibility
acceptance.criteria: Reject nonexistent dependency endpoints, self-dependency and cycles. Existing v5 boxType/kind values can still be displayed as legacy metadata, while v6 writes add no project.items, parentId, task.dependsOn, built-in Box type, or built-in relation kind.

acceptance.title: Regression gate
acceptance.criteria: UI6-01..09 pass on candidate and published Pages, Core vNext contract tests pass, long-text regression passes, and unexpected console/page/API errors are zero.

mergeGate.candidate: UI6-01..UI6-10 must pass against the exact Pages artifact builder
mergeGate.published: UI6-01..UI6-10 must pass against GitHub Pages after merge
mergeGate.human: Real-device human acceptance is required for final product acceptance
mergeGate.criteriaChange: Do not weaken this plan in place; create a new plan version for requirement changes
